standard_prerequisites.name: The description of an injective hull of the residue field as the increasing union of the submodules killed by the powers of the maximal ideal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1090-1091)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the filtration whose endomorphisms compute the endomorphism ring.

standard_prerequisites.name: The identification of the endomorphism ring of each finite length truncation with a quotient of the local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 1098)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies each term of the limit with the corresponding quotient of the local ring.

core_obligations: Use the filtration: write the hull as the union of the submodules E_n = E[m^n] as in the cited description and observe that every endomorphism preserves this filtration (proof lines 1090-1092)

Pass to the limit: consequently the endomorphisms of the hull are the limit of the endomorphisms of the truncations, and each truncation is a module over the quotient of the local ring by the n-th power of the maximal ideal (proof lines 1093-1095)
Identify the limit: the endomorphism ring of each truncation is that quotient, so the limit is the completion of the local ring (proof lines 1096-1098)
proof_roadmap: 由 union-artinian 引理，E = ∪ E_n，E_n = E[m^n]。
任一端同态保持该滤过 ⇒ Hom_R(E,E) = lim Hom_R(E_n,E_n)。
由 evaluate 引理 Hom_R(E_n,E_n) = Hom_{R/m^n}(E_n,E_n) = R/m^n，取逆极限即 R 的 m-进完备化。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the endomorphism ring of an injective hull of the residue field of a Noetherian local ring with the completion of that ring (author lemma at source lines 1082-1087, label lemma-endos). The proof (source lines 1089-1099) writes the hull as the union of the submodules killed by the powers of the maximal ideal, notes that endomorphisms preserve this filtration, and evaluates the resulting limit termwise, where each term is the corresponding quotient of the local ring. The passage to the limit is the substance. H2.
